===Mine layout===
Rocks fall on certain tiles around the mine; these [[rockfall]]s block access to veins or other areas of the mine, and will deal 1-4 damage to any players on the tile. Removing them requires a pickaxe and rewards 10 Mining experience each. [[Runite Minor]] and the other [[Miner (Motherlode Mine)|miner]]s may occasionally remove these rockfalls, though they usually just mine pay-dirt. [[Box trap]]s and other traps placed on the ground may be laid to temporarily prevent rockfalls from blocking a path, until the trap collapses.

Near [[Prospector Percy]] is a bank chest that can be accessed without any requirements, though this cannot be used to bank pay-dirt (see the cleaning pay-dirt section below). There is also a [[Dark tunnel (Motherlode Mine)|dark tunnel]] next to it, an [[Agility]] [[shortcut]] (requires {{SCP|Agility|54|link=yes}} and completion of the medium [[Falador Diary]]) that connects the east side of the mine to the centre. There is a similar tunnel to the south which does not require diary completion.

====Upper level====
Unlocking the upper level of the mine requires base {{SCP|Mining|57|link=yes}}, and a one-time fee of 100 [[golden nugget]]s paid to [[Prospector Percy]]. It can be accessed from a [[Ladder (Motherlode Mine)|ladder]] north of the bank chest.

The upper level consists of 64 ore veins clustered closer together than on the lower level. These ore veins deplete at a much slower rate, depleting after 36-40 seconds instead of the usual 23-27 seconds.
